body.x: Cresyn showed premium audio brand ‘Phiaton’ at Korea Electronics Show 2017 (KES) held for 4 days from October 17 (Tuesday) to 20 (Friday) at KOEX in Samsung-dong.

Cresyn has specialty in audio equipment for 60 years, and its own brand Cresyn was created in 2002. In addition to this, Cresyn integrated brands after the launch of premium brand Phiaton in 2008, and has continued its professional development of earphone and headphone.

Mr. Jang Sung-hwa, manager of strategic planning team, was quoted as saying “Consumers love Phiaton’s design and technology”, and he continues “Lots of products are entertaining convenience and consumer’s needs like long music play, Bluetooth function, noise reduction, and handy storage function.

In the meantime, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
